# WinRing0 vendor binaries

Place these files in this folder (already copied from Razer Update Tool if present):

- `WinRing0x64.dll`
- `WinRing0x64.sys`
- `WinRing0.dll` / `WinRing0.sys` (optional, 32-bit)

The app requires **Administrator** rights to load the driver.

Antivirus software often flags WinRing0. Add this folder to exclusions if the driver fails to load.
